title: THE FASHION RACKS FILL THEIR PANEL
why: Seen on the FASHION screenshot of 2026-10-07: the racks list was capped at a fixed height, so on a 1080p screen it stopped a third of the way down its panel, cutting through the EYES row with blank space below, while the whole window scrolled for the long slot list on the left. Each column now fills the window and scrolls on its own.
now: In FASHION the racks use the whole panel and scroll on their own, as does the slot list on the left.
